rows.claim: When two sources hold at one boundary, the termination record names the first in the order control stop, t_end, stop requests
rows.evidence: probe:250 (t_end equal to the request's boundary time 0.4 gives ModelRequestedStop, not EndTimeReached); src/sim.jl:2090-2091 and 2134 (a request is returned right after the publication, before the next frame top reads the stop word or t_end at 2095-2096); log D-268 line 11804 records face-before-interrupt
rows.fix: The loop checks the stop requests at each publication, which comes before the next frame top. The frame top then checks a pending control stop and then `t_end`. When two sources hold at one boundary, the termination record names the request.
